parameters.content:
## Enterprise pattern: demand-driven replenishment

This workflow turns a stock snapshot into calculated replenishment proposals, groups them by handling policy and creates five complete `ORDERS05` messages. The decision is explainable (`target stock - projected availability`), retries are idempotent and each wave carries a purchase-order reference that can be reconciled in SAP.

It covers regular stock, serial numbers, FIFO batches, expiry-controlled batches and advanced receiving with the real A4H/250 product catalog.
